name: Lori's Nightmare
desc:
[ alpha ]

Summer 1996, it was just a fun sleepover with friends… but the old tapes hid something terrible. The experiments held at the institution have finally resurfaced.

📺 CHILDREN: Sneak through the dark and restore the TVs.

🌙 NIGHTMARE: Hunt children and prevent them from restoring the TVs.

Uncover the twisted past of a forgotten child 🧸 .
This is a horror game.
